paths.description: Entry/listing template and primary content discovery journey; also tested at desktop, 360px, dark, contrast, reduced-motion and keyboard-focus conditions.
Bollywood category listing, representing taxonomy/listing templates.
Current title detail page, representing content details and the primary download-link journey.
Movie request/comment form, representing input, validation, long-comment and recovery states.
How-to-download instructional content template supporting the primary journey.
Synthetic missing URL to verify HTTP failure handling.

findings.summary: The theme does not adapt to the user’s color or contrast preference.
findings.evidence: Desktop, dark-preference and increased-contrast screenshots are pixel-identical; the site remains a fixed dark palette. Axe also reports 58 definite contrast failures on the request page.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme, provide light/dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), and add a forced-colors/prefers-contrast treatment.

findings.summary: State changes and long scrolling receive no modern motion or gesture affordances.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no authored View Transitions, scroll timelines or scroll snap; reduced-motion probing showed only generic transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive View Transitions for meaningful state changes and CSS scroll-driven/gesture primitives where they clarify navigation, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Extremely long pages provide little scroll-state or attention guidance.
findings.evidence: The request page is 235,614px high with 41,039 DOM nodes (one layout run reached 952,345px); probes found no scroll-state query, progress indicator, anchor positioning, or post-navigation highlighting.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a sticky progress/back-to-top affordance, clear in-page section navigation, and robust anchored placement for transient controls.

findings.summary: Custom banners/dialog-like UI add noise and do not use semantic dismissible primitives.
findings.evidence: The first viewport is dominated by two navigation rows and a warning banner; DOM probes found custom role=dialog containers but zero dialog, popover or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce repeated chrome and implement optional announcements with native dialog/popover semantics and predictable light dismiss.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is visually suppressed and some controls are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline-style:none across sampled buttons, links and inputs; the category toggle measured 22x22px and the navigation toggle 40x38px.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and enlarge interactive targets to at least 44x44 CSS pixels with adequate spacing.

findings.summary: The core download journey hands users to opaque third-party destinations without clear state or recovery.
findings.evidence: The detail flow exposes format links to gadgetsweb.xyz and hubdrive.tips in new tabs; the page does not explain the destination, safety, progress, expiry, or recovery if it fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Label external destinations and consequences clearly, keep a trustworthy intermediary state, and provide retry/back/report-link recovery.

findings.summary: Primary pages are heavy and slow, with poor LCP and substantial blocking work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage LCP 6.5s and interactive 11.7s. CDP traces measured LCP 2.36s/2.87s but 402ms/517ms TBT. HARs transferred 4.50MB over 137 requests and 4.79MB over 147 requests; the request page transferred 5.26MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, lazy-load below-fold media, reduce render-blocking resources, and remove duplicate/unused scripts.

findings.summary: Accessible names, landmarks and heading structure are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Axe found 60 unnamed poster links, an untitled iframe, nested interactive search, no main landmark and no H1 on home; request has an unnamed select and 7,536 regions outside landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every link/frame/select an accessible name, remove nested controls, add one main landmark and a logical H1-led heading hierarchy.

findings.summary: Request-page text and links fail contrast and non-color distinction requirements.
findings.evidence: Axe reported 58 definite color-contrast failures and 42 links distinguishable only by color on the request page.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text/background contrast to WCAG AA and distinguish inline links with underline or another non-color cue.

findings.summary: A production JavaScript syntax error breaks runtime hygiene.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured SyntaxError: Unexpected token } in wp-content/themes/9xhd/script/script.min.js?v=1.9v3.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the malformed bundle, add production error monitoring, and block releases on uncaught syntax/runtime errors.

findings.summary: Images lack sizing, responsive sources, lazy loading and modern delivery.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 63/63 homepage images without dimensions, 57 below-fold images not lazy, 61 without srcset, and 62 legacy-format images. Lighthouse estimates 225KiB unused JS and reports unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height, provide srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold images, and serve WebP/AVIF at appropriate resolutions.

findings.summary: Search/share metadata is incomplete despite strong server rendering.
findings.evidence: Raw content coverage is 100% on home and 91% on detail, with robots and sitemap present, but home has no canonical, no H1, only og:type, and no JSON-LD; the raw homepage title was not detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-canonical, stable H1, complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata, and accurate schema.org JSON-LD for site and content entities.

findings.summary: All major defensive response headers are absent and analytics cookies are insecure.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. Four Google analytics cookies lack Secure and all five cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; set Secure and an appropriate SameSite policy on cookies.

findings.summary: The page has a broad, undisclosed third-party tracking and delivery footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 20 third-party origins including Google Analytics, DoubleClick and Tag Manager; homepage HAR recorded 137 requests and 4.50MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise third parties, remove duplicate analytics, gate nonessential tracking behind informed consent, and self-host/cache essential assets where practical.

findings.summary: Locale presentation is hard-coded and not translation-ready.
findings.evidence: The document declares en-US while content mixes English and Hindi; dates appear as Jul-24th, 2026 and CSS/DOM inspection provides no locale switch, hreflang or evidence of Intl-based formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Use BCP 47 language tags per locale, Intl date/number formatting, hreflang for translated variants, and logical CSS properties.

findings.summary: Trust signals and form assistance are weak in the primary journeys.
findings.evidence: The warning claims an “official” domain while download links redirect to unrelated hosts. Request inputs omit autocomplete; invalid submission relies only on browser messages with no aria-invalid, describedby or live region.
findings.suggestedFix: Use transparent destination and ownership copy, avoid coercive/ambiguous redirects, add correct autocomplete tokens and accessible inline error summaries.

findings.summary: Network, media and background work exceed a reasonable content-listing budget.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 3.45MB of homepage images, 541KB of fonts and 20 third-party origins; 57 below-fold images load eagerly and Lighthouse found duplicate/unused analytics and library code.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a per-template byte/request budget, lazy-load media, subset/self-host fonts, remove redundant third-party code and pause nonessential background work.

findings.summary: The request page has an excessive memory and DOM footprint.
findings.evidence: Heap summary reports 922,966 heap nodes and 68.8MB self size; DOM probe counted 41,039 elements. By comparison the homepage used 268,481 heap nodes and 14.9MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Paginate or virtualise comments, cap initial comment rendering, defer offscreen subtrees with content-visibility, and remove duplicated comment forms/listeners.
